findings.assessment: Committed-source construction bypasses the shared snapshot validator. It constructs Snapshot and calls project directly, returning only initial read_snapshot path diagnostics. A stale spec-to-plan binding rejected for the same working-tree bytes becomes an ordinary committed hierarchy with no diagnostics. Validate the fully captured immutable snapshot through the existing shared authority before publishing its view; surface invalid/missing committed dependencies honestly without borrowing checkout inputs.
findings.reproduction: Create the existing pilot fixture on a live agent/pilot branch, increment specs/current/pilot.json revision without updating work/pilot/test-plan.json spec_digest, then commit. Opening working-tree source has projection=None. Select git:agent/pilot: projection is present and view.diagnostics=[]. Calling view.captured.diagnostics(root) returns [{code: EM001_CANONICAL_DEFINITION, path: work/pilot/test-plan.json, message: spec_digest_mismatch: }]. No invalid-source warning appears in committed mode.
